product.olivetti-m6-880.summary: The EISA tower in the M6 range with a Pentium · 60 MHz.
product.olivetti-m6-880.history: Olivetti included it among the EISA M6 towers. In April 1994, ASCII reported its Japanese offer at ¥998.000 with 525 MB and ¥1.098.000 with 1 GB.
product.olivetti-m6-880.architecture: The processor sits on a dedicated card. The card plugs into the motherboard and includes 256 KB of L2 cache.
product.olivetti-m6-880.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m6-880.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.

product.olivetti-m6-880.firmware: The revision helps identify the service BIOS. The guide lists 1.2 · rev. 1.2.
